The MA process was conducted in a planetary ball mill (QM-3SP4) at a rotation speed of 350 rpm of dry milling.

Subsequently, the milled powders were dried in a vacuum drying chamber at 80 ◦C for 2~3 days to volatilize ethanol and later monoaxially compressed into a cylindrical die with a hydraulic press of 30 MPa.

Subsequently, they were sintered via the SPS technique (LABOX-650F, NJS Co., Ltd. SPS Center, Tokyo, Japan) at 1150 ◦C with a heating rate of 50 ◦C/min and a duration of 10 min. During SPS, an identical pressure of 45 MPa was set and the vacuum pressure was kept below 20 Pa.
